data.name: desktop_app_name
data.comment: The application's name, shown in the window title and the tray. A name: keep it as it is in every language.

data.name: app_already_running
data.value: An instance of Libreccio Weather is already running.
data.comment: Dialog shown in the running application when another launch is attempted. Libreccio Weather is the application name and stays untranslated.

data.name: desktop_interface_section
data.comment: Settings > Appearance: title of the section holding the desktop interface switch.

data.name: desktop_interface_title
data.comment: Settings > Appearance: switch that adapts the interface for mouse and keyboard.

data.name: desktop_interface_on
data.value: Smaller corners and mouse and keyboard navigation.
data.comment: Settings > Appearance: summary under the desktop interface switch while it is on.

data.name: desktop_interface_off
data.value: Adapt the existing interface for desktop use. Changes apply immediately.
data.comment: Settings > Appearance: summary under the desktop interface switch while it is off.

data.name: desktop_open
data.comment: Verb. Opens a location from its right-click menu in the location list, opens the main window from the tray menu and the tray popup.

data.name: desktop_move_up
data.comment: Location list right-click menu: moves the location one place up.

data.name: desktop_move_down
data.comment: Location list right-click menu: moves the location one place down.

data.name: desktop_remove
data.comment: Location list right-click menu: deletes the location.

data.name: desktop_location_actions
data.comment: Location list: hint that a right-click shows the location's actions.

data.name: display_refresh_rate
data.value: Animations at the screen's refresh rate
data.comment: Settings > Appearance > Interface: switch running animations at the refresh rate of the monitor, such as 144 or 165 Hz. Turned off, they run at 60 frames per second, which asks less of slower computers.

data.name: tray_change_location
data.comment: Tray icon menu: submenu listing the saved locations to show.

data.name: tray_exit
data.comment: Tray icon menu: quits the application.

data.name: tray_dismiss
data.comment: Tray icon menu: hides the tray icon until the next refresh. Offered only when the tray icon is not persistent.

data.name: tray_section
data.comment: Settings > External modules: title of the tray icon section. Mistray is the name of the tray feature: keep it as it is in every language.

data.name: tray_icon
data.comment: Settings > External modules: switch showing the icon in the Windows notification area, the tray.

data.name: tray_temperature_icon
data.comment: Settings > External modules: switch drawing the temperature as the tray icon.

data.name: tray_weather_icon
data.comment: Settings > External modules: switch adding a second tray icon with the weather condition next to the temperature icon.

data.name: tray_accessibility
data.comment: Settings > External modules: section title above the double-click delay.

data.name: tray_double_click
data.value: Double-click the tray icon to open the app
data.comment: Settings > External modules: switch making a double-click on the tray icon open the main window.

data.name: tray_double_click_delay
data.comment: Settings > External modules > Accessibility: the longest time between two clicks that still counts as a double-click.

data.name: tray_milliseconds
data.comment: Unit shown after the double-click delay field: the CLDR short symbol for milliseconds in the language.
